description: This file defines the code-behind for the UserProfile page in an online examination system. It handles page loading by fetching user details from a SQL database and populating form fields. It also manages navigation between pages via button click events, including logout and redirection to other pages.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind class for the UserProfile web page handling user data display and page navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; retrieves user info from database if session exists, otherwise redirects to login.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended to handle profile button click, currently commented out.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.
